about.title: About MEDIBRIDGE
about.desc: MEDIBRIDGE helps patients connect with doctors and communicate comfortably across language barriers through online and in-clinic healthcare services.
about.step1Desc: Search verified doctors by speciality, spoken language, location, and consultation mode.
about.step2Desc: Reserve real in-clinic time slots or enter live video consultation sessions immediately.
about.step3Desc: Engage via secure two-way video and audio directly in your browser with real media streams.
about.step4Desc: Request an available live interpreter whenever patient and doctor speak different languages.

footer.disclaimer: MEDIBRIDGE is not intended for medical emergencies. If you are experiencing a life-threatening medical emergency, please contact your local emergency services immediately.
